肋间神经的走行：第 7 肋平面的断面（上面观）

text.aria-label: Sympathetic ganglion and rami communicantes — 交感神经节与交通支
Posterior ramus (to the back muscles and skin) — 后支（到背部肌和皮肤）
text.tspan: Posterior ramus (to the back muscles and skin)

text.aria-label: Lateral cutaneous branch — 外侧皮支

svg.text: Leaves the intervertebral foramen; the anterior ramus turns laterally
and is joined to the sympathetic trunk.
出椎间孔；前支转向外侧，并与交感干相连。
Near the spine it lies between the internal intercostal membrane and
在脊柱附近，位于肋间内膜与壁层胸膜之间。
From about the angle of the rib it runs in the costal groove, between
the internal and innermost intercostals, below the vein and artery.
大约从肋角起走在肋沟内，位于肋间内肌与肋间最内肌之间，在静脉和动脉下方。
Near the midaxillary line the lateral cutaneous branch pierces the
在腋中线附近，外侧皮支穿出肌层到皮肤。
Beside the sternum it turns forward and ends as the anterior
在胸骨旁转向前方，终末为前皮支。

text.aria-label: The nerve is drawn on the inner side of the rib; in life it lies under the — 神经画在肋骨内侧；实际位于肋骨下缘的深面，
text.tspan: The nerve is drawn on the inner side of the rib; in life it lies under the
神经画在肋骨内侧；实际位于肋骨下缘的深面，

text.aria-label: lower border of the rib, hidden from above. — 从上方看被肋骨遮住。
text.tspan: lower border of the rib, hidden from above.
Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
